text:
Rowan: quick sync  decision time: welcome rail with checklist tiles at top of console, or a short 3-step mini-tour overlay? Im leaning rail (resumable).
Priya: rail +1. Persistent surfaces drive completion. Mini-tours get ignored after the first dismiss.
Diego: research agrees  rail had higher D1 engagement in the last test. Tour is good for immediate attention but not for follow-up.
Lina: accessibility notes: if we ship a rail it needs a skip-link target, aria-live announce only on first render, chips must be in tab order with visible focus rings, and text over images must meet AA contrast.
Eli: dev estimate: rail MVP (compact tiles/chips) ~2 dev days + a11y pass. Mini-tour spike ~1 day. Hybrid idea? show a one-time overlay that highlights the new rail for first-run.
Rowan: hybrid seems best: overlay-once to draw attention, then leave the rail as the persistent surface. Use a stateless route param to launch samples: /projects/new?onboard_hint=welcome and local flag to avoid re-show.
Priya: copy suggestion: header = "Welcome — Try a starter" sub = "Run one in under 5 minutes" CTA on tiles = "Run sample". Analytics: welcome_rail_shown, tour_shown, sample_started. I'll own event names and funnel.
Lina: I'll add an a11y checklist to the PR template: skip-link, aria-live first-render, focus return on close, contrast check.
onboard-bot: Reminder: attach Figma handoff + component tokens by EOD Friday.
Rowan: final decision: hybrid MVP  one-time overlay pointing to the persistent welcome rail, route-param for sample launch, instrument analytics, a11y checklist in PR. Eli to open branch, Priya to own analytics & copy, Lina to do a11y review. Thanks! :rocket:
